svg.text: Layered modular monolith. Every request passes the API-tier security pipeline before a module runs. Modules talk only through interfaces or the Event Bus. Solid arrow = request flow, dashed = «use» dependency.
Provided interfaces: IClosetAPI · IAuthToken · IPreferences · IWardrobe
IAvailability · IRecommend · IWeather · IIntentParser · IInsights · IAdminAPI
Events: UserRegistered · ItemCreated · ItemDeleted → Smart Shopping · OutfitWorn · AccountDeleted
one schema per module · every row carries user_id
accounts · profile · wardrobe · availability · planner · outfits
bcrypt passwords · lockout after 5 failures · JWT with token version
(logout and suspend end sessions) · admin routes require role
· another user’s row → 404 · secrets only in environment variables
chooses ONE of 14 whitelisted functions, fills its arguments;
never sees photos or the database · keyword parser if down
